basis.reason: The repeated footer precedes unused space after a kept row break. Each row is 14pt line height + 8pt padding + 0.5pt collapsed border = 22.5pt. The table starts at 10.25pt, and the footer follows one header and three body rows on pages 1 and 2, or two body rows on page 3. Its glyph baseline adds 4.25pt padding/border plus 7 + (1901-483)*10/(2*2048) from the locked font hhea metrics. PDF y is 140 minus that baseline. Only F is selected; spanning-cell alignment is not assumed by this assertion.

basis.reason: CSS Inline 3 inline-height uses only the first available font for non-normal layout bounds. STIX hhea ascent 1055 and descent -455 at 1000 units/em yield a 10pt baseline offset for 10pt/14pt text. Three 14pt lines start at page y=10pt; PDF marker baselines are 80, 66 and 52pt. Fallback glyphs must not enlarge those lines, including in a child span.

CSS Inline 3 inline-height includes all glyph metrics for normal layout bounds. U+214A is absent from DejaVu Sans and present in STIX. Its 10.55pt ascent and 4.55pt descent exceed the first font metrics; after the three fixed 14pt lines the baseline is 10+42+10.55pt from the page top, or PDF y=37.45pt.
